notes.title: Patch 0.0.1.4
notes.content:
Tiny patch
[list]
[*] Added clearer UI for casting/discard
[*] Slight Adjustment to elite fight placement
[/list]

We are noticing a lot of players rushing to elites and dying. To alleviate this, we added an extra fight before the elites that are close (<2 fights before reaching the elite).

Thanks
-G/B

notes.title: Small update: version 0.0.1.3
notes.content:
Pluto version 0.0.1.3 is live! 

We noticed the feral orc shaman had a 0% win rate so we’ve adjusted that fight. 

New fights have been added across the map and we’ve made some adjustments to spells. 

We’ve also added a lot of small quality of life updates, mostly focused on giving you better feedback from the spells in your hand and making them easier to manage. we recommend replaying the updated tutorial to get better acquainted.

Thanks -G/B
